history.summary: A Shiva temple at Pandaria village in the Barkagaon block of Hazaribagh district (CSV town 'Hazaribag' corrected — the temple is in Barkagaon, PIN 825311, not Hazaribagh city). No published history or founding date was found; local video coverage calls it an ancient temple steeped in legends, but this is unverified. Directory listings rate it about 4.4 stars and show daily hours 06:00–21:00. Coordinates are for the Barkagaon locality, approximate.

name: Budhwa Mahadev Mandir, Hazaribag
town_description: Barkagaon is a town and community-development block in Hazaribagh district, Jharkhand, about 20–25 km west of Hazaribagh city, in the coal belt of the North Karanpura coalfield. It is a rural market centre surrounded by villages such as Pandaria, with a mixed agrarian and mining economy. The block also hosts the NTPC Pakri-Barwadih coal mining project nearby.
